Authentication/authorization for vector DB requires changes across extension interface, vector DB implementation, RAG extension, and all callers. Affects thread-level isolation, file ownership validation, and operation auditing - architectural cross-cutting concern affecting 5+ files.

Authorization for thread/assistant/message operations requires comprehensive refactoring across conversational extension, thread service layer, API contracts, and all operations (list, create, modify, delete). Needs context/session management throughout the system - affects 5+ files.

Path validation fix is scoped to file ingestion handler in RAG extension and vector DB file intake. Requires implementing path resolution validation and whitelist checks - localized to 2-3 files with clear validation logic.

Session limit and rate limiting implementation for model loading in llamacpp extension. Requires adding concurrent load limits, throttling, resource monitoring - localized to extension load manager with clear patterns for Tier 1 DoS mitigations.

Backend string validation is a known pattern - whitelist validation against supported backends. Can use deterministic enum/regex validation following standard practices. Single location in llamacpp extension.
localStorage security is deterministic pattern - replace with sessionStorage or add encryption. Known mitigation pattern for browser storage. Single file change.

Creating IPC abstraction layer requires refactoring service layer architecture across 5+ service files, test files, and Tauri command handlers. Affects services/index.ts, services/models/default.ts, and all services calling tauri.invoke. Cross-cutting architectural change.

Standardizing extension dependency injection affects all extension modules (RAG, llamacpp, MLX, conversational, vector-db). Requires defining ExtensionInterface contract, refactoring dependency patterns across 5+ extension files with lifecycle implications.

Separating business logic from containers requires creating new service layer files (MessageProcessingService, ProviderValidationService, DownloadOrchestrationService) and refactoring 3+ large container files plus their service consumers. Cross-cutting architectural refactor affecting 6+ files.

Establishing command adapter pattern requires creating CommandHandler trait, unified response wrapper, and refactoring 5+ command files (app, filesystem, threads, models, assistants, etc.). Architectural change affecting Rust command layer and potentially TS side.

Establishing testing architecture with clear boundaries requires creating test utilities, mocking factories, and test fixtures. Localized to test infrastructure and documentation - affects multiple test files but follows standardizable patterns.

Unifying i18n system requires standardizing configuration between web-app and docs (2 locations), potentially creating shared translation CLI tool. Scoped to configuration and tooling layers without affecting core application logic.
